Honeywell Technologies: Build What Matters

At Honeywell Technologies, you can work on technology that helps make the world safer, smarter, and more efficient. We are a global automation company focused on helping customers run critical operations safely, reliably, and efficiently, with about $17B in 2025 sales, 54,000 employees, roughly 600 sites, and headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

Work on practical innovation.

Honeywell Technologies is moving from automation toward autonomy by combining AI, controls, connected data, and domain expertise to help assets work harder, people work smarter, and processes run more efficiently.

Grow with purpose.

At Honeywell Technologies, you can grow your career and network by contributing to the company’s success. Join a customer obsessed culture built on respect, collaboration, diverse perspectives, continuous learning, individual well-being, and celebrating achievement.

Be part of a culture that values people.

Our people are at the heart of what we do, with an emphasis on impact, representing Honeywell with pride, bringing diverse perspectives, and solving problems with curiosity and resilience.

Shape the future by making what matters better.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join a team that designs, develops and integrates highly complex software applications within Honeywell Technologies. You will be an active and integral member of a team to achieve the completion of goals. You will also generate innovative solutions in work situations, trying different and novel ways to deal with problems and opportunities. Use your skill set to provide value added software features to our products for our customers. Accelerate innovation and growth, teaming with the world's most talented engineers.

We invite you to discover for yourself why a career with Honeywell Technologies is the opportunity you've been looking for!

Location: This position is available in multiple locations across the United States.

The exact worksite location will be selected based on business requirements and the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications.

The hourly base range for this position is $25.50/hr - $45.00/hr. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- Must be currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or similar field

- Must graduate in December 2027 or later

- Must continue enrollment in degree program upon completion of the internship

- Validated academic excellence (3.0 GPA and higher)

- Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status

Honeywell Technologies is currently unable to consider applicants who would require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization for this position. Candidates must be authorized to legally work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements.

WE VALUE:

- Understanding various software development lifecycle

- Ability to develop efficient and high-quality software

- Knowledge of software configuration management and change management practices

- Diverse and global teaming and partnership

- Excellent oral and written communication skills

- Effective communication

- Ability to quickly analyze, incorporate and apply new information and concepts

- Ability to consistently make timely decisions even in the face of complexity, balancing systematic analysis with decisiveness

Interning at Honeywell Technologies provides hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, professional development, and mentorship within a global organization. Interns will receive relocation benefits and short-term housing if they are 50 miles or more from their assigned work location (excluding Puerto Rico and Canada).

The application period for the intern position is estimated to be through the end of March 2027; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Market Operations Leadership Development Program — New Graduate

Most jobs ask you to figure out your future before your first day. This one doesn't.

This is an 18 to 24 month leadership development program that leads to an operations leadership role in one of our last mile delivery locations, iconic car Vending Machines, or new car showrooms across the country.

Even better than that, every six months you'll apply what you’ve learned through mentorship and coursework to get certified in a different part of how Carvana actually operates.

About the Opportunity:

Our Leadership Development Program starts where many Carvana leaders did, the Market Operations Customer Advocate role. Along with creating memorable experiences on the driveway or at our state of the art Car Vending Machine, you’ll also:

- Put our AI and products to work every day (we're a tech company that also sells cars), learning the systems that move a car from click to customer.

- Learn how a world-class fulfillment operation moves cars, haulers, and people from first to last mile, and build the skills to lead one.

- Drive our signature car hauler (the image of Carvana on the road that we designed ourselves) to deliver a curated experience that our customers will never forget.

- Get your hands on the whole operation, from the detail bay to the driveway, learning the work by doing it instead of reading about it.

- Learn and work at our unmistakable car Vending Machines.

- Develop leadership skills and credentials that will unlock career opportunities in driving fast-growth operations.

Who we're looking for

- You earned your Bachelor's degree in the last three years

- You're drawn to customer-obsessed operations that are tech-forward, fast-growing, and complex enough to never get boring.

- You're curious how a real company actually runs, end to end, not just the part in front of you.

- You want a program with a real finish line, one built to launch you into operations leadership.

Benefits + Perks:

We continually invest in our team members’ success because when our team members grow, we grow. Here is how we invest in you:

- Compensation: Competitive, Performance-Based Compensation PLUS 401(k) with Carvana match, opportunity for overtime during busy seasons

- Health & Wellness: 100% Company Paid Healthcare Premiums plus Dental + Vision benefits. Wellness program to support mental, physical and financial health. We know pets are family too! Benefit from our pet care savings program to keep your furry friends healthy and happy.

- Time Off & Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off (13 days for the first year, increases to 20 days thereafter)

- Equity: Carvana Shares is something that we grant to our team members on an annual basis where you get to be an ‘owner’ in the company. We also offer an Employee Stock Purchase Plan discount!

General qualifications and requirements

- Ability to perform physically demanding tasks like detailing vehicles and loading/unloading vehicles onto our haulers in indoor and outdoor conditions with occasional exposure to inclement/extreme weather (some markets may require deliveries to be made in the snow, while other markets require deliveries to be made in the summer heat).

- Ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours)

- Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat

- Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items of 50lbs.

- Frequent driving requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity. Reasonable accommodations may be granted to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Legal stuff

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

All applicants must pass a drug test and obtain a DOT Medical Card. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Responsibilities

The Multimedia Data Scientist position at TikTok focuses on optimizing the app experience for users through data-driven solutions. The role involves collaboration with various teams to enhance content creation journeys, utilizing statistical models and data mining techniques to identify opportunities for personalized user publishing experiences. The ideal candidate will work in a fast-paced environment, contributing to the development of metrics and monitoring capabilities, conducting experiments, and providing actionable insights based on data analysis.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities
- Develop the experience metric system and the corresponding monitoring capability across different stages of creation
- Conduct experimentation, define launch standards and provide suggestions on experiment iterations
- Quantify the impact of creation tool performance on user behavior, such as publish rate, retention, and engagement
- Use data mining for understanding user needs and build models that enable personalized publishing experience
- Work with various partners on landing solutions that meet the needs for evolving products
- Build systemic problem solving capability and research on cutting-edge methodologies

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline
- Experience in data science roles, preferably working on mobile application performance analysis and user experience optimization
- Experience working with creation-oriented user behavior
- Proficient in SQL and Python; experience with big data tools such as Hive or Spark.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience within the entertainment industry, streaming, social applications
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment with rapid product iterations
- Experience in A/B testing, metric design, and causal inference.

Company Overview:

For more than 50 years, NISC has developed and implemented enterprise-level and customer-facing software solutions for over 960+ utilities and broadbands across North America. Our mission is to deliver technology solutions and services that are Member-focused, quality driven and valued priced. We exist to serve our Members and help them serve their communities through our innovative software products, services and outstanding customer support. NISC has been ranked in ComputerWorld’s Best Places to Work for twenty-two years, and we are looking for qualified individuals to join our team.

Our Members have over 18 million end customers (residential and businesses who receive power, internet, television and/or telephone services) that our enterprise software solution enables our Members to compete effectively in the industry, while excelling in customer service.

This position reports to a Software Engineering Team Lead and will collaborate with other software developers. May work with support staff assigned to design business requirements and with quality assurance personnel. This position is responsible for software development and assisting with the maintenance of NISC’s Utility, Broadband, Financials, Operations software and/or mobile applications.

- Lake Saint Louis, MO

- Mandan, ND

- Performs basic research, design and development of software systems.

- Researches, analyzes, and resolves basic software maintenance.

- Assists in the enhancement and/or maintenance of application programs in the business areas listed above within our Application Development Division.

- Follows all established software development methodologies and procedures.

- Performs quality testing as it relates to both unit and system integration dependent on the tasks assigned.

- Reviews and prioritizes assigned change requests.

- Ensures that all information is appropriately entered and utilized in Confluence and/or the iVUE Support tool.

Desired Job Experience:

- Strong customer orientation.

- Familiarity with Object Oriented Concepts & Languages (Java and it's frameworks, preferred).

- Familiarity with Javascript and it's frameworks (newer Angular versions or Typescript preferred).

- Familiarity with HTLML/CSS/SCSS and enterprise design patterns.

- Familiarity with relational and non relational databases (e.g. Postgres, Oracle, MongoDB, Cassandra)

- Familiarity with Linux and Microsoft Windows.

- Familiarity with cloud technologies (preferably AWS)

- Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail.

- Strong verbal and written, interpersonal, and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment.

- Ability to effectively adapt to change.

- Ability to interact in a positive manner with internal and external contacts.
